selected_direction: Raw chronological magnetic sequence representation with a small causal temporal convolution model
hypothesis: The order of past measurements may contain discrimination lost by mean/std/last/delta and longer-history summaries. This is untested, not demonstrated.

input_contract.population: Frozen V2 forecast keys retained; missing histories padded/masked, never silently dropped
input_contract.preflight: Reconstruct original 96 summaries from the raw sequence and explain every discrepancy; verify source hashes, cadence and clocks before fitting

controls: Shorter-training 96-feature control identified in calibration-windows-v1; secondary control because training history differs
Same small temporal model on label-independent per-window permutations of interior timesteps; first and last observations preserved, all measurement/mask channels permuted together
permutation_scope: Preserves unordered values and first/last summaries; cannot isolate measurement-order effects from the ordering of missingness. Do not provide original timestep IDs to the shuffled control.

budget.pilot: Runtime/storage/causality smoke check only; no validation-based architecture search

selection: Architecture, optimizer and stopping rule must be frozen in execution protocol after data/resource checks; do not choose best outer year or seed. Report seed variation and a predeclared seed aggregation.
evaluation: Original annual folds; all new main arms share training/calibration/evaluation rows. Early inner training folds only for any development selection, never outer evaluation labels. Earlier outer years are already inspected development, not fresh test.
threshold: Calibration-selected target recall >=0.95 transferred unchanged; no evaluation-reselected threshold as main result.
success: Higher precision and fewer false-positive windows at recall >=0.95 per comparable positive year, plus probability/ranking and paired-HARP uncertainty checks. Consistent improvement over order-destroyed control required to support ordering hypothesis. No automatic promotion.
parked: Further small calibration-duration, probability-pooling or weight grids without a new hypothesis
Flare-history features until report-availability and region-association provenance are verified
Alert suppression as a substitute for window-level precision improvement
Large Transformer or broad architecture search before the bounded sequence pilot
limitations: No guarantee sequence modeling improves precision; limited independent positive regions remain.
Reference paper is general sequence modeling, not evidence of solar-flare performance.
Full architecture/training implementation and raw-sequence materialization are not completed.
